answer: In a thread polling the preferred pigment level for a mural named nadir, the server sorts numeric ballots, discards the ten highest and ten lowest, and averages the rest; it rejects the poll if fewer than 21 arrive. To retain an extreme ballot beyond all honest values, an attacker must submit at least 11 such ballots, costing submission effort. Automation can make that cheap, and trimming also discards genuine preferences.
